question: Loan-to-deposit ratio trend by banking organization for New England organizations with $10B-$50B in assets since 2024
headline: Three New England organizations with $10B-$50B in assets had loan-to-deposit ratios between about 89% and 96% in 2026Q2, with Beacon Financial the highest at 95.57%.
insights: Beacon Financial Corp fell from 103.17% in 2024Q3 to 95.57% in 2026Q2, a change of -7.60 percentage points, and was the highest of the three in every quarter.
Eastern Bankshares Inc rose from 87.43% to 89.21% over the same span (+1.78 pp), and was the lowest of the three in 2026Q2.
Independent Bank Corp (MA) moved from 92.47% to 89.72% (-2.74 pp), with its ratio roughly flat at 90-92% since 2025Q1.
Ratios are aggregate loans over deposits on quarter-end balances, pro forma for mergers; only three organizations fall in this New England and $10B-$50B group in the data.
